banks.label: + Add Your Own
banks.guide_ref: This row is a signpost, not a lane. If you only want to tell your own story, pick 'my_story' (My Story) instead and type it in -- no code required. To DEVELOP a bank: author a folder under user_packs/source_banks/<your_bank_id>/ (bank row, fetch/interpret module, at least one story pack), run 'otr_check bank <path> --activate', and restart ComfyUI -- your bank then appears in this dropdown as its own entry, an equal peer of every shipped bank. The contract is apple/EXTENDING.md, which ships with the pack; developing a bank also needs the GitHub clone, because otr_check lives under scripts/ and a registry install does not carry it.
